name: StackAvatar
description: Initials avatar for teammates in group orders, profile cards, and joined-member stacks.
accessibility: The component applies aria-label with the full name.
Do not rely on avatar color alone to identify a user.

do: Use the ring prop when avatars overlap on dark surfaces.
Use stable teammate colors within the same order.
dont: Do not use random colors that change across renders.
Do not show avatars without a nearby name when identity matters.
